description.value: Momi Noodle is a downtown Victoria restaurant specializing in authentic Guilin rice noodles, street snacks, and handcrafted Asian drinks. The menu centres on individual claypot hotpot noodles and traditional rice noodle bowls, with catering also available. Customer reviews highlight soul-soothing broths and a cozy atmosphere, making it a notable dining stop on Pandora Avenue.
